questions.title: Instructions
questions.body: To be completed daily, with all questions fully answered, before midnight.

questions.description: Just a simple description of how you spent your free time for the day.
List what you drank today, excluding water.
List exact titles of what you watched with bbfc classification. If none, write "None."
List exact titles only. If none, write "None."
Note how long you spent watching porn, and what you watched if not 0.
Note how long you spent in chastity today. If you are required to be in chastity, calculate and note the remaining time in the box. If you've completed your chastity today, note "Free."
Note down particularly strong feelings, especially related to commands I gave you. If none, write none.
List all time you spent doing tasks/chores assigned by me. Note down what you did, or select '0' if none.
List anything you asked me permission for since the last survey, and whether you were granted or denied permission.

questions.prompt: What is the current word count of your book?

questions.description: Choose an option to indicate if you want to do some extra worship! If you chose an option it's up to me how I'll implement it/if I will. All decisions are final, and selecting something here indicates you are willing and have time to do it the following day.

questions.prompt: General Thoughts/Other things done for me
questions.description: A place for you to put general thoughts so I can keep track of your mood and what you're enjoying/not enjoying. If you did anything for me not mentioned in previous responses make sure to note it here.
